observation.command:
docker run --name postgis -d -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgrespw -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=ffy_dev postgis/postgis:17-3.5 2>&1 | tail -2
docker run --name valkey-cache -d -p 6379:6379 valkey/valkey:8.1.4 valkey-server --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --port 6379 2>&1 | tail -2
docker run --name valkey-queue -d -p 6380:6379 valkey/valkey:8.1.4 valkey-server --maxmemory-policy noeviction --port 6380 --appendonly yes 2>&1 | tail -2
sleep 5; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'
